request.objective: Combine unequal group counts to calculate a return proportion, distinguish tablet weighting from desk weighting, and separate a descriptive result from an explanation of desk performance.

inputs.text: Fictional library service note: the small desk issued twelve loaner tablets during the trial week; nine came back before closing. At the large desk, twelve of the forty-eight issued tablets came back before closing. Both desks used closing time on the same Friday as the return deadline.

The loan records identify individual tablets. Each tablet was issued once at exactly one desk during this week; there were no transfers between desks. The two desks served different borrower groups, and the note gives no reason for the difference in their return patterns.

The service team wants the fraction of all tablets issued during the week that were returned by the common deadline. One colleague instead proposes giving the two desk percentages equal weight. The library also operated a staff equipment service, whose records are not included here.

inputs.text: 虚构校园观察社共有50名登记成员。名册在两次活动之间没有变化，两次活动都仅向这50名成员开放。
观察步行活动签到表记录了35名不同成员，图片讨论活动签到表记录了30名不同成员。每张表内部已经去重，但尚未核对两张表中的姓名。成员可以两次都参加。
汇总记录没有保存两次都参加的成员数。组织者想知道这50名成员中至少参加过一次活动的比例；本记录不包括非成员观看公开照片的访问次数。
